title: Present perfect continuous and simple (I have been doing and I have done)
subtitle: Процесс или результат; how long или how much / how many

theory.text: Оба времени связывают прошлое с настоящим, но смотрят на ситуацию по-разному. have been doing — нас интересует сам процесс (закончен он или нет — неважно). have done — нас интересует результат, действие завершено.

head: have been doing — процесс
have done — результат
rows: I've been painting the kitchen. (на одежде краска)
Ben has been eating too many sweets.
Have you ever worked on a farm?

items: «Как долго» (действие ещё идёт) — continuous: How long have you been writing this report? They've been playing chess since lunch.
«Сколько, сколько раз» (законченные порции) — simple: How many pages have you written? We've played chess four times this week.

theory.text: know, have (= иметь), like, believe и др. в continuous не ставим: I've known Anna for ten years. How long have you had this phone? Исключения: want и mean — I've been meaning to call Lisa. I've been wanting to see this film.

Если в русской фразе есть число или количество («три письма», «десять клиентов», «сколько страниц»), это почти всегда present perfect simple, а не continuous: I've written three letters, а не I've been writing three letters.

items.ru: (на одежде краска) Я красил кухню.
en: I've been painting the kitchen.

items.ru: (кухня теперь белая) Я покрасил кухню.
en: I've painted the kitchen.

items.ru: У меня грязные руки, потому что я чинил машину.
en: My hands are dirty because I've been fixing the car.
My hands are dirty because I've been repairing the car.
My hands are dirty because I've been fixing my car.

items.ru: (он больше не течёт) Я починил кран.
en: I've fixed the tap.
I've repaired the tap.

items.ru: Кто-то съел весь торт.
en: Somebody has eaten all the cake.
Someone has eaten all the cake.

items.ru: В последнее время Бен ест слишком много сладкого.
en: Ben has been eating too many sweets recently.
Ben has been eating too many sweets lately.
Ben has been eating too much sugar recently.

items.ru: Что ты сделал с моей ручкой?
en: What have you done with my pen?

items.ru: (ты весь в грязи) Ты играл в футбол?
en: Have you been playing football?

items.ru: Как долго ты пишешь этот отчёт?
en: How long have you been writing this report?

items.ru: Сколько страниц ты уже написал?
en: How many pages have you written?
How many pages have you written so far?
How many pages have you already written?

items.ru: Эмма всё утро звонит клиентам.
en: Emma has been calling clients all morning.
Emma has been phoning clients all morning.
Emma has been calling customers all morning.

items.ru: Сегодня Эмма позвонила десяти клиентам.
en: Emma has called ten clients today.
Emma has phoned ten clients today.
Emma has called ten customers today.
Today Emma has called ten clients.

items.ru: Они играют в шахматы с обеда.
en: They've been playing chess since lunch.
They've been playing chess since lunchtime.

items.ru: На этой неделе мы играли в шахматы четыре раза.
en: We've played chess four times this week.
This week we've played chess four times.

items.ru: Я учу японский, но выучил пока немного.
en: I'm learning Japanese, but I haven't learnt much yet.
I'm learning Japanese, but I haven't learned much yet.
I'm studying Japanese, but I haven't learnt much yet.
I'm studying Japanese, but I haven't learned much yet.

items.ru: Сколько кофе ты сегодня выпил?
en: How much coffee have you drunk today?
How much coffee have you had today?

items.ru: Сколько раз ты была в Лондоне?
en: How many times have you been to London?

items.ru: Я знаю Анну десять лет.
en: I've known Anna for ten years.
I've known Anna for 10 years.

items.ru: Как долго у тебя этот телефон?
en: How long have you had this phone?
How long have you had that phone?

items.ru: Я давно собираюсь позвонить Лизе.
en: I've been meaning to call Lisa for a long time.
I've been meaning to phone Lisa for a long time.
I've been meaning to call Lisa for ages.

items.ru: Я давно хочу посмотреть этот фильм.
en: I've been wanting to see this film for a long time.
I've been wanting to see this movie for a long time.
I've been wanting to watch this film for a long time.
I've wanted to see this film for a long time.

items.ru: Мы гуляем по городу весь день.
en: We've been walking around the city all day.
We've been walking around the town all day.
We've been walking round the city all day.

items.ru: Сколько километров вы прошли?
en: How many kilometres have you walked?
How many kilometers have you walked?

items.ru: Ты когда-нибудь работал на ферме?
en: Have you ever worked on a farm?
